content: GOAL: Ground a novel hyperbolic SID-table metric before proposing. READ: listed working directory and searched for Issue #126 / Q_H definitions and SID table schema. OBSERVED: (to fill). EVIDENCE: filesystem under round_20261029_231855. REASONING: need to know exactly what the frozen reference exposes (source/target reps, temperature) and what the exported SID table columns are so the formula is implementable and not a duplicate. OPEN: identify reference temperature and whether training pairs are available.

FINAL METRIC (recorded because the full block exceeds the 4000-char progress limit): hyp_prefix_gibbs_enrichment_k10.
Construction: Poincare ball curvature -1. For each item i with >=1 training positive, q_i = hyperbolic Karcher/Frechet barycentre of the source vectors s_u of all training users who interacted with i. tau = frozen reference temperature. w_i(j)=exp(-d_H(q_i,t_j)/tau) for j!=i, Z_i=sum_{j!=i}w_i(j). Fix K=10 and l*=deepest level with K_l <= N/K (else 1). C_i = B_l*(i)\{i}, c_i=|C_i|. E_i=0 if c_i=0, else E_i=ln( W_i / ((c_i/(N-1))*Z_i) ), W_i=sum_{j in C_i}w_i(j). M=mean_i E_i over anchored items.
Why: W_i/Z_i is the share of the reference's full temperatured negative mass in i's own cell; c_i/(N-1) is the exact size-matched null share. E_i is a pointwise mutual information: 0 for random or collapsed or singleton cells, positive for geometric alignment, negative for anti-alignment. Uses audience barycentre + full negative distribution + codebook-size-matched level; self excluded so a peaked reference cannot win via the anchor itself.
Known results addressed: avoids collapse (1-cell table gives exactly 0), avoids bucket-size bias (exact size null), differs from Q_H (single anchor + mean of 10) and from all failed partition-geometry/coverage/margin/likelihood variants.
Compute: <=6.0e8 Poincare distances, blocked float32, logsumexp, ~40-60 s CPU.
Risks: tau recovery, boundary clipping, l*=1 for most 256-code tables, noisy audience barycentre for rare items.
Worst case: anti-aligned hash at the chosen resolution (strongly negative); collapsed/fully identified tables score 0.
This record supersedes record 2. No further work; the full formatted answer is printed in the response.
